searchText: would be good to get someone from Nimbus to chime in on https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/457 as we had previous discussion regarding 415 error codes on their repo and closed the issue there to first define this on the spec will look as a general point, the issue we had before was not per se 415, it was freelancing HTTP error codes outside of spec the goal of the PR is mostly to be more specific about 406/415 HTTP error codes in the spec as those are relevant if we wanna adopt ssz more broadly but clients are already using HTTP error codes outside of the spec, e.g. 404 is often used as "not implemented" while this is not defined in the spec

excerpts.content: would be good to get someone from Nimbus to chime in on https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/457 as we had previous discussion regarding 415 error codes on their repo and closed the issue there to first define this on the spec

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: as a general point, the issue we had before was not per se 415, it was freelancing HTTP error codes outside of spec

excerpts.content: the goal of the PR is mostly to be more specific about 406/415 HTTP error codes in the spec as those are relevant if we wanna adopt ssz more broadly
